title: Nourishing Light Polish Blackeye Pea Pilaf
description: A yeasty and light Polish dish featuring blackeye peas, miso marinate, and vegetarian friendly ingredients, providing a nourishing and energizing meal option. This pilaf is perfect for a healthy and satisfying dinner.
instructions: Rinse the dried blackeye peas and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the soaked blackeye peas, then set them aside.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste and 1/4 cup of the vegetable broth until smooth.
Add the miso mixture to the pan with the onion and garlic, and stir to combine.
Add the soaked blackeye peas, remaining vegetable broth, yeast, salt, and pepper to the pan, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 30 minutes or until the blackeye peas are tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
